rows.en: Touya: "I got so caught up in it... Before I knew it..."
that I'm his and Dr. Wenimas's daughter..."
Touya: "Yeah... After you were taken away, Ymir."
Celica: "But that doesn't mean Ymir stops being Ymir,
does it? Nothing's changed between us, right?"
Celica: "There, there. Now, about this Rayode...
Celica: "Everyone, get away! It's still alive!"
Sharl: "...Now that both sides are exhausted,
Touya: "Tch! We can't afford to be attacked now..."
Lyle: "........I... I won't hurt anyone dear to me
with them... Besides, I've failed as a father..."
Touya: "H-Hey! What the hell are you going to do?!"
Celica: "No way! How can it still move?!"
Sharl: "...What do you think you're doing?"
Lyle: "I'll give you Rayode's 'Core' and my life.
Sharl: "...You seem to be under some misapprehension.
Your life has no value. It's nothing but worthless garbage.
There's no bargain to be made."
Lyle: "Heh... I see... No good, after all...
Then how about your life instead?"
Sharl: "You intend to fight me in that condition?"
Sharl: "Heh heh heh... That's why I asked,
'You intend to fight me in that condition?'
Lyle: "Heh... I knew that perfectly well...
I just needed to get inside your guard..."
Sharl: "What are you going to...!! Don't tell me!"
Lyle: "I told you, didn't I? I'd give you my life..."
Sharl: "Impossible... Even if you do that,
But it'll leave you no choice but to withdraw..."
Sharl: "Lyle... A fool to the very end..."
Rishuna: "Hah, hah... I'm sorry... We're late..."
Valga: "It certainly takes a toll on an old body."
Valga: "My power is limited, but against you in your current state,
I can put up quite a fight, you know?"
Sharl: "I've recovered the 'Core,' and as for Rayblade,
I suppose it can wait until next time...
We'll have to settle things with you, too, sooner or later."
keep yourself standing as it is, can't you?)

Preserve eight-dot pause27, Rayode/Core versus Rayblade distinction, Sharl cruelty and Lyle sacrifice as fictional combat without unprinted mechanism. Sharl survives/claims Core recovery, no invented mutual death or Rayblade-Core identity. Valga private words separate from speech, Rishuna exhausted not medically diagnosed. No actual harmful instructions or new resurrection.
